title: Punishment for Murder
description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
punishment: Death or Imprisonment for Life + Fine
cases: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab
K.M. Nanavati v. State of Maharashtra

title: Mob Lynching
description: When a group of five or more persons acting in concert commits murder on the ground of race, caste, community, sex, or belief.
punishment: Death or Imprisonment for Life + Fine
cases: Tehseen Poonawalla v. Union of India

title: Punishment for Rape
description: Sexual intercourse with a woman against her will or without her consent.
punishment: Rigorous Imprisonment (10 years to Life) + Fine
cases: Mukesh & Anr v. State for NCT of Delhi (Nirbhaya Case)

title: Sexual Intercourse by Deceit
description: Sexual intercourse by employing deceitful means (false promise of employment or marriage) without intention to fulfill it.
cases: Anurag Soni v. State of Chhattisgarh

title: Assault to Outrage Modesty
description: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty.
cases: Rupan Deol Bajaj v. KPS Gill

title: Stalking
description: Following a woman, contacting her despite disinterest, or monitoring her internet usage.

title: Dowry Death
description: Death of a woman caused by burns/injury within 7 years of marriage due to dowry harassment.
cases: Satbir Singh v. State of Haryana

title: Theft
description: Dishonestly taking any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent.
punishment: Up to 3 years or Fine or Both
cases: K.N. Mehra v. State of Rajasthan

title: Snatching
description: Theft is 'snatching' if the offender suddenly or quickly seizes or grabs property from a person.

title: Extortion
description: Intentionally putting a person in fear of injury to deliver property.

title: Criminal Breach of Trust
description: Dishonest misappropriation of property entrusted to someone.

title: Cheating
description: Deceiving a person to deliver property or consent to retain property.

title: Organised Crime
description: Kidnapping, robbery, vehicle theft, contract killing, etc., by a crime syndicate.
punishment: Death or Life Imprisonment (if death results)

title: Terrorist Act
description: Acts threatening the unity, integrity, sovereignty, or economic security of India.
cases: Ajmal Kasab v. State of Maharashtra

title: Unlawful Assembly
description: An assembly of 5 or more persons with a common illegal object.

title: Rioting
description: Force or violence used by an unlawful assembly.

title: Driving Without License
description: Driving a motor vehicle without a valid license.

title: Drunk Driving
description: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
cases: Alister Anthony Pareira v. State of Maharashtra

title: Driving Without Helmet
description: Riding a motorcycle without wearing a protective headgear.

title: Dangerous Driving
description: Driving at a speed or in a manner dangerous to the public (e.g., jumping red lights, using phone).
